subject: planner: lift the canPushToCop check of logical join/window/selection (#62206)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on planner MPP plan enumeration changes in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`, `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`, and `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/logical_selection.go`. The lifted `CanPushToCop` gating for join/window/selection now relies on task-type satisfaction and per-operator `Attach2Task`/pushdown checks (e.g., selection pushdown via `expression.CanExprsPushDown`, MPP window support checks, MPP hash join attachment requiring `MppTask`) to prevent invalid MPP plans from being chosen. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/data consistency/transaction-session behavior within the touched planner logic.
